January 15, 1976
Federal Power Commission Washington, D. C. 20426
Attention: Mr. Plumb
Secretary to the Director
Subject: Comments to Draft Environmental Statement
Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project
Project No. 2740
Oconee County, South Carolina
Gentlemen:
Enclosed are comments prepared by the South Carolina Chapter of Trout Unlimited to the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the above referenced project. We respectfully request that a review of our comments be made by the FPC Staff and that the substantial questions raised concerning this project be addressed.
Very truly yours,
Robert F. Martin, P.E. President-South Carolina Chapter
Encl.
